depends_on.name: subject_id
depends_on.documentation: The subject measured. The writer always populates this.

depends_on.name: manipulation_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional link to a manipulation. NEVER set by any writer on origin/main.

depends_on.name: protocol_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional link to a protocol. NEVER set by any writer on origin/main.

fields.name: ontology_name
fields.documentation: The CURIE of the measured quantity (e.g. NCIT:C81328 = weight). Spelled `ontologyName` in did_v1. ALWAYS a resolved CURIE -- the writer gets it from ndi.ontology.lookup and errors if lookup fails, so this binding is genuine.

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human label of that ontology node.

fields.name: numeric_value
fields.documentation: The numeric value of the measurement.

fields.name: string_value
fields.documentation: The string value. POLYMORPHIC -- the consumer (ndi +fun/+docTable/treatment.m) dispatches it as numeric, datetime, a nested ontology CURIE, or plain prose, based on the dataType the ontology lookup returns for the node.
